question: When the actual-Live +0.50 USD loss-reversal state is expressed causally as 0.125 of birth planned risk, does any one strategy show a broad, repeated native loss burden across frozen CXR2 history while the portfolio still contains material late-maturing winners?

parent.copy_rule: one-time copy into this family; no include, link or execution dependency on the parent after derivation

retained_from_unit_020.actual_state: T09, T11 and T14 each reached at least +0.50 USD before finishing nonpositive; five of nine actual winners peaked in the final quarter of native life
retained_from_unit_020.translation: +0.50 USD divided by the approximately 4 USD birth planned risk is fixed at 0.125R

fixed_variants.CONTROL: Identity-separated exact CXR2 economic control with no observer calls.
fixed_variants.PROFIT_MEMORY_OBSERVER: The same source and economics plus read-only per-tick floating-profit memory and one post-native-close observation row. The observer cannot call a trade function or alter component, portfolio, execution, decision, risk or persistence state.

run_matrix.model: FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks, 100% real ticks

fixed_observation.birth: A component position_identifier becoming nonzero after native admission and fill.
fixed_observation.mark: Current selected position floating profit on every dispatched US30 real tick, with the latest causal US100 quote for US100 positions.
fixed_observation.birth_planned_risk: The unchanged component entry_planned_risk_usd captured at birth.
fixed_observation.mfe_r: Maximum observed floating profit divided by birth planned risk.
fixed_observation.mae_r: Minimum observed floating profit divided by birth planned risk.
fixed_observation.native_stressed_r: The unchanged component stressed-net increment at native close divided by birth planned risk.
fixed_observation.peak_fraction: Elapsed seconds from birth to MFE divided by elapsed seconds from birth to native close.
fixed_observation.profit_memory_reversal: mfe_r is at least 0.125 and native_stressed_r is nonpositive.
fixed_observation.late_maturity_winner: native_stressed_r is positive, mfe_r is at least 0.125 and peak_fraction is at least 0.75.

implementation_contract.identity: CONTROL and OBSERVER use separate release, Portfolio, Magic, state, event, snapshot, lock and observation paths.
implementation_contract.observer_state: Private transient measurement state only; it is never serialized into the economic state files.
implementation_contract.observer_calls: One pre-dispatch mark/sync call before the Tester scheduler early return and one post-dispatch sync call after native processing.
implementation_contract.close_result: Computed only from the component stressed-net increment after native close; the observer never initiates a close.
implementation_contract.allowed_source_differences: Family identity/path declarations, thin variant entrypoints, one conditional assembly include/call seam and the observer module.
implementation_contract.forbidden: Any signal, admission, size, stop, protection, close, timeout, RC4, Passive, order, persistence-schema or session-clock change.

fixed_integrity_gate: Both variants compile on build 6140 at 0 errors and 0 warnings before any run.
For every adjacent period pair, all normalized report summary, order and deal rows are equal and final lifecycle/stressed-net totals match exactly.
State A/B, current A/B and lock evidence are equal after identity normalization; event economic rows are equal after excluding observer-only rows and the existing deal_wait_ms wall-clock field.

Observer rows equal the observer variant's completed native lifecycle count with no duplicate position_identifier, unmatched birth/close, nonpositive planned risk, missing sample, MFE below MAE, crossing-order or time-order fault.

Required US30, US100 and US500 symbols database plus contract/swap fingerprints are unchanged before and after every adjacent pair. Any change invalidates the full matrix and no economic verdict is made.
All runs stop normally with zero safety, persistence, broker, foreign, protection, ownership or observer fault.

requirements: At least five profit_memory_reversal lifecycles in at least three periods.
Profit-memory reversals are at least 20% of all native nonpositive lifecycles for the strategy.
Their pooled mean native_stressed_r is at most -0.20R.
Their summed giveback_r is at least 12R.
Their mean native_stressed_r is negative in at least three periods with at least five reversals.
fixed_information_gate.selection: Select at most one passing strategy by larger summed giveback_r, then more reversal lifecycles, then more passing periods, then lexicographic strategy name.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain one later entry-preserving, strategy-specific profit-memory management Proxy question. No action type or threshold is selected in Unit 021.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close the actual-position bundle naturally. Do not rescue with another threshold, direction, symbol, weekday, period, MFE bin or pooled all-strategy rule.

late_maturity_guard.portfolio_pass: At least 40 pooled late_maturity_winner lifecycles and at least eight in three periods across the whole portfolio.
late_maturity_guard.strategy_reporting: For every strategy, report late-maturity count, period breadth, share of positive lifecycles and summed post-75%-life MFE opportunity; it cannot rescue a failed burden gate.
late_maturity_guard.effect: Any retained management Proxy must keep the native position open at the first 0.125R crossing and compare a reversible memory response rather than assume immediate close or unconditional breakeven.

stop_rules: Freeze source, binary, eight configurations and symbol fingerprints before opening the first path.
Run exactly the eight serial paths and no optimization.
If environment fingerprint changes, invalidate and close without a clean rerun inside Unit 021.
Do not use T15 replay repair, operating events, manual-close timing or Live logs as outcome data.
Do not select an action, stop offset, trail, floor, hold change, strategy exception or Live candidate from the observation.
Do not reopen generic cohort coordination or same-symbol directional unlock.
